ordered.title: The red oil light is the most urgent warning on your dashboard
ordered.description: The red oil warning light is the single most urgent warning on your dashboard. It means your engine has lost oil pressure - and without oil pressure, your engine destroys itself in seconds.

blocks.text: In our 24,650 quote dataset, we identified five primary causes of oil warning lights:

items: Low oil level (45% of cases) - Simply low oil. Top-up fixes it. Cost: £60-£150.
Oil pump failure (20% of cases) - Pump not circulating oil. Cost: £492-£1,009+.
Oil pressure sensor failure (15% of cases) - False alarm - sensor faulty. Cost: £100-£300.
Bearing wear (12% of cases) - Worn bearings causing pressure drop. Cost: £800-£10,000+.
Oil sludge/blockage (8% of cases) - Blocked oil pickup or galleries. Cost: £300-£1,500+.
RED oil can = Low oil pressure → STOP DRIVING IMMEDIATELY
YELLOW oil can = Low oil level → Check as soon as possible
RED oil can (flashing) = Intermittent pressure → Stop and diagnose

blocks.text: The £5,000 Mistake: Ignoring a red oil warning light is the fastest way to destroy your engine. A £60 oil top-up could have saved a £5,000 engine replacement.

Don't fall for these dangerous misconceptions

cards.text: “The light came on briefly but went off - it's fine now.” If the light came on, the engine lost oil pressure briefly. That brief loss can cause permanent bearing damage.
cards.fullText: “The light came on briefly but went off - it's fine now.” If the light came on, the engine lost oil pressure briefly. That brief loss can cause permanent bearing damage.

cards.text: “I'll just add oil when I get home - it's only 5 miles.” 5 miles without oil pressure is 5 miles of metal-on-metal contact. The engine can seize in seconds.
cards.fullText: “I'll just add oil when I get home - it's only 5 miles.” 5 miles without oil pressure is 5 miles of metal-on-metal contact. The engine can seize in seconds.

cards.text: “My car has a dipstick - I'll check it later.” Check it NOW. Before you start the engine again.
cards.fullText: “My car has a dipstick - I'll check it later.” Check it NOW. Before you start the engine again.

ordered.title: Use the symptom pattern to understand the repair range
⚠️ RED OIL LIGHT = STOP DRIVING IMMEDIATELY
ordered.description: If the red oil light comes on while driving:

items: PULL OVER SAFELY - Find a safe location immediately
TURN OFF ENGINE - Do not wait. Turn off the key immediately
DO NOT RESTART - Not even to "check if it's still on"
CHECK OIL LEVEL - Wait for the engine to cool (at least 10 minutes)
CALL FOR RECOVERY - Do not drive

blocks.text: Why This Is Critical: Oil pressure is what keeps metal parts from touching. Without oil pressure, metal-on-metal contact destroys bearings. Bearing failure can happen in seconds. Once bearings fail, the crankshaft is damaged - the engine must be replaced.

blocks.text: The Real-World Rule: "If the red oil light is on, the engine is not receiving oil pressure. Even if it's a sensor fault - assume the worst until proven otherwise."

cards.title: What to do next
cards.text: Step 1: STOP DRIVING (Immediately) - Pull over safely. Turn off engine. Do not restart. Step 2: Check Oil Level (When Cool) - Wait 10+ minutes. Check dipstick. Is oil at the correct level? Step 3: If Oil Level Is Low - Top up to the correct level (£60-£150). Wait 1 minute. Check if the light has gone out. If light is out - monitor closely. Step 4: If Oil Level Is Normal OR Light Stays On - Arrange recovery to a garage. Do not drive. Book a diagnostic (£50-£150). Step 5: Professional Diagnostic (£50-£150) - A technician will check oil pressure with a mechanical gauge, test the oil pressure sensor, inspect the oil pump, check for bearing wear (oil analysis), and examine oil filter for metal particles.

blocks.question: What does the red oil light mean?
blocks.answer: Low oil pressure. Your engine is not receiving oil. Stop driving immediately.

blocks.question: Can I drive with the oil light on?
blocks.answer: No. Not even a short distance. The engine will be destroyed within minutes.

blocks.question: What's the difference between red and yellow oil lights?
blocks.answer: Red = low oil pressure (emergency). Yellow = low oil level (check soon).

blocks.question: How much does oil pump replacement cost in the UK?
blocks.answer: Oil pump replacement costs £492-£1,009 depending on the vehicle and engine access.

blocks.question: How long can an engine run without oil pressure?
blocks.answer: Seconds. The red oil light means the countdown to engine destruction has already started.
